SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT RQDT.BUYER , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ , RQDT.REVISION FROM KEPRQDT RQDT WHERE RQDT.BUYER = 'KRSSAN0025' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO NOT LIKE 'RE%' AND RQDT.SND_CHK = 'N' AND RQDT.ATOB_SEND_FLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY RQDT.BUYER , RQDT.QUOTATION_NO , RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT RQDT.QUOTATION_NO AS RFQ_NO , RQDT.REVISION AS RFQ_SEQ , '1' AS QT_SEQ , RQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS ITEM_CODE , QTDT.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE , RQDT.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION FROM KEPRQDT RQDT INNER JOIN KEPQTDT QTDT ON (1 = 1 AND QTDT.BUYER = RQDT.BUYER AND QTDT.QUOTATION_NO = RQDT.QUOTATION_NO AND QTDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ AND QTDT.REVISION = RQDT.REVISION AND QTDT.STATUS = 'C' AND QTDT.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y' ) WHERE RQDT.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND RQDT.QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND RQDT.REVISION = $G_RS.REVISION$
UPDATE KEPRQDT SET SND_CHK = 'Y' , SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION = $G_RS.REVISION$
